name: ECE 6171
title: Mobile Robotics
description: Coordinate transformation, kinematics and dynamics, sensor modeling, specifics of camera sensors, inertial measurement unit (IMU) sensor, simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), EKF-SLAM, Monte Carlo localization, SLAM observability, robot control, specifics of vision-based control, and aspects of Human-robot interaction; class project with a project report.
requirement_description: Recommended preparation: MATH 2410Q, MATH 3160 or STAT 3345, ECE 3111 and familiarity with MATLAB programming.
